_doc: US IT-staffing/consulting H1B sponsors whose job portals are BROWSER-GATED (JobDiva/iCIMS/Bullhorn/custom JS SPAs) and therefore NOT directly HTTP-scrapable — see the contract-vendor investigation 2026-08-09. Rather than fragile headless scraping, we reach their roles via LinkedIn SYNDICATION: these firms push postings to LinkedIn/Indeed/Google Jobs, so the linkedin_scanner runs a bounded set of company-scoped queries for them. `platform` is the detected ATS (why they're gated). `linkedin_probe` = how many get company-scoped LinkedIn queries per scan (kept small for account safety).
